##### Project general facts

Future Avenue is a contemporary residential development shaped around a quieter interpretation of modern luxury, with a strong focus on comfort, connection and family life. The concept brings together thoughtfully designed architecture, open spaces and a warm, welcoming atmosphere, creating a home environment where everyday living feels calm and effortless. Generous glazing, expansive outdoor spaces and carefully integrated greenery create a seamless relationship between the residences and the surrounding environment, while the overall design combines contemporary elegance with a sense of warmth and belonging.

The development offers a lifestyle centred around leisure, wellness, family activities and social connection. Residents can enjoy swimming pools and relaxation areas, rooftop leisure spaces, outdoor cinema, landscaped areas, dedicated fitness facilities and spaces for yoga and exercise. Sports amenities include padel, volleyball and basketball areas, while children have access to dedicated playground spaces designed for active play and exploration. The development also incorporates places for socialising and gathering, as well as cafés, retail and everyday conveniences, creating an environment where residents can connect, unwind and enjoy a variety of activities without leaving the community.

The residences are designed with a refined contemporary aesthetic, combining warm wood tones, soft neutral colours, elegant lighting and carefully considered decorative details. The living spaces are bright and welcoming, with large windows, comfortable furniture, integrated storage and thoughtfully arranged open-plan layouts that bring together living, dining and kitchen areas. Contemporary kitchens are designed as an integral part of the interiors, with sleek cabinetry, refined surfaces and built-in appliances, while the overall palette creates a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. The interiors balance modern elegance with functionality, creating comfortable homes designed for quiet mornings, family gatherings and everyday moments together.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is emerging as a dynamic hub where residences, leisure, nature and connectivity intersect, positioned near the bustling heart of the city while remaining within reach of the historic downtown core. The area enjoys immediate proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and the celebrated Downtown district, creating effortless access to premier shopping and cultural experiences. This strategic setting invites residents to partake in a vibrant urban narrative that is still unfolding.

The neighbourhood benefits from seamless links to the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, the innovative Dubai Design District, the waterfront Dubai Creek Harbour and the renowned Meydan Racecourse, ensuring a rich tapestry of recreation and commerce. A protected wetland teeming with hundreds of wildlife species adds a rare ecological dimension to city living. Furthermore, direct routes to the international airport streamline global travel for occupants.

Natural allure permeates the surroundings, featuring an expansive central park, shimmering crystal lagoons, a scenic canal and a breezy boardwalk that weave through the community. These amenities foster an outdoor lifestyle that balances serenity with activity. As the district continues to expand with new homes, leisure venues and lifestyle concepts, it promises sustained growth and enduring appeal.
